scope: Canonical OT1995 Records, four named workspace projections, and current chunk1 Render Input if present; no recursive enumeration
anchor_method: GitHub-style rendered heading slugs with duplicate suffixes plus explicit HTML id/name; Markdown heading extraction only
limitations: External URLs and network paths are catalogued without fetching.
Fragments of non-Markdown targets are reported as not checked, not missing headings.
Generated-heading slugs are a local consistency approximation; unusual inline HTML or Markdown extensions may require manual anchor review.
